value: Embedding SRE principles, DevOps culture, and intelligent automation at QBE.
Embedding site reliability engineering, DevOps, and intelligent automation into QBE's delivery lifecycle.
To embed site reliability engineering principles, DevOps culture, and intelligent automation across QBE Account's delivery lifecycle for safer, faster, and more reliable releases.
To build a QBE Account delivery engine that is self-healing, highly observable, and continuously improving through SRE practices and a blameless culture.
Reliability by design, automate everything, learn from incidents, and measure outcomes — not activity. Every failure is a learning opportunity.
